I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It uses a `Pricing` trait with three implementing types, `Plain`, `Bulk` and `Member`.

I ran it in the interpreter on the first example plus an unknown-kind line and a blank line. Its output matched the expected output: `$4.50`, `$89.91`, `$75.00`, `invalid kind`, and a total of `$169.41`. I didn't run the second example (zero quantity) or any other edge cases,
